The '''Obtrexta sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]] and [[the Wastes]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Obtrexta included [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].

It was one of the endpoints for the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] [[Myto's Arrow/Legends|Myto's Arrow]].<ref name="TEA" />

It was one of the [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] that comprised the [[Pentastar Alignment]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TEA" />
